rows.jyutping: V dak1 jau5 lei5 jau5 geoi3
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone presents an argument clearly with sound reasons or evidence.

example.english: They explained it cogently, so everyone immediately understood why the proposal needed changing.
example.traditional: 佢講得有理有據，大家即刻明白點解要改方案。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dak1 jau5 lei5 jau5 geoi3 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 ming4 baak6 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 goi2 fong1 on3

rows.jyutping: V dak1 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the argument convincing or persuading other people, rather than specifically on its evidence.

example.english: They argued cogently, and even the people who initially objected nodded.
example.traditional: 佢講得有說服力，連最初反對嘅人都點頭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dak1 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 lin4 zeoi3 co1 faan2 deoi3 ge3 jan4 dou1 dim2 tau4
